source.subject: test: retain M64N256 CA NVFP4 cell

purpose.question: Does transferring only the proven activation-A cp.async.ca operator to the frozen M64xN256 topology preserve its independent two-CTA scheduling while reusing activation data through L1?
purpose.answer: Yes. The same-topology A-only-CA candidate improves every formal round and lowers Gate latency by 2.581645%, making it the fastest measured native test-only cell, but it remains 0.084407 ms above the unchanged absolute admission gate.
purpose.classification: retain as the current fastest native test-only development baseline; do not admit to production
purpose.production_route: unchanged hybrid direct-dequant plus cuBLASLt bridge

shape_and_topology.grid: 68 N tiles x 8 M tiles = 544 CTAs
shape_and_topology.mma: sixteen inline mma.sync.aligned.m16n8k16 BF16 accumulator fragments per warp
shape_and_topology.weight_and_scale_cache_operator: packed B and scales retain cp.async.cg
shape_and_topology.scale_reuse: one K256 16-byte scale window per output row, retained for four K64 stages
shape_and_topology.packed_weight_copy: paired adjacent lanes fill both 16-byte halves of one canonical 32-byte packed row
shape_and_topology.comparison_baseline: the identical frozen M64xN256xK64 topology with A, B, and scales on cp.async.cg

sass_cache_operator_evidence.measurement: static LDGSTS instruction sites in the instantiated kernels, not dynamic traffic

control_m64n256_cg.bypass_role: activation A, packed B, and scales

sass_cache_operator_evidence.independent_instruction_diff: A row-by-row CA/CG SASS audit found only the six activation LDGSTS cache modifiers and their corresponding control words different; all other instructions match.
sass_cache_operator_evidence.conclusion: The compiled candidate changes only activation A from cache-global/bypass to cache-all; B, scale, arithmetic, tile, pipeline, and epilogue code remain identical.

correctness_and_rejection_contract.independent_audit: pass with no blocking code, ABI, resource, correctness, Graph, cache-operator, or production-isolation findings

protocol.candidate: the identical M64xN256 topology with only activation A on cp.async.ca; B and scales remain cp.async.cg
protocol.pair_stop_loss: skip Gate+Up pair unless the single-Gate candidate clears both the positive-round and absolute-latency gates

aggregate.decision: retain as the current native test-only baseline; reject production admission

comparison_to_prior_fastest_native_cell.interpretation: Applying A-only cache-all without changing the faster M64 topology recovers the M128 cell's topology cost and establishes the new fastest native test-only result.

screen_log.expected_exit: nonzero solely because the absolute candidate gate rejects the otherwise six-of-six positive cell

protocol.clock_control: none inside Nsight Compute; the system was already fixed at MAXN CPU/GPU/EMC clocks
protocol.use: causal attribution for the same topology and sole A-cache-operator change, not formal latency
protocol.warning: Nsight Compute did not flush caches or change clocks. Same binary, M64xN256 topology, resources, arithmetic, B/scale operators, and epilogue are compared; SASS confirms the only instruction differences are the six A-copy cache modifiers and their control words. The CPU-pinned B-C-C-B screen remains authoritative for latency.

nsight_compute_comparison.interpretation: Because topology and compiled work are identical except for the six activation cache modifiers, the 14.9294% L2-request and 45.8234% bypass-byte reductions are attributable to A-only cache-all under this profile. Higher tensor and issue activity, lower MIO throttle, and the 2.6479% profiled duration reduction align with the independent 2.581645% formal latency reduction. The candidate still is not admissible because the frozen absolute gate, not NCU, controls production entry.

independent_audit.findings: no blocking code, ABI, resource, correctness, Graph, cache-operator, or production-isolation findings
independent_audit.sass_equivalence: CA/CG row-by-row SASS differs only in six activation LDGSTS cache modifiers and their corresponding control words; all remaining instructions are identical
independent_audit.timing_caveat_resolution: pass; the formal screen was rerun with taskset CPU 11 while system MAXN CPU 2.2016 GHz, GPU 1.3005 GHz, and EMC 3.2 GHz clocks were already fixed

decision.candidate: current fastest native test-only baseline, rejected from production admission
decision.retained_value: keep the exact implementation and evidence because the isolated cache-policy transfer is uniformly positive and its causal mechanism is confirmed on the same topology
decision.absolute_gate: unchanged and failed by 0.084407 ms; 1.566357% additional latency reduction is required

next_bounded_work.direction: select one decode-structure or instruction-scheduling cell using the same-topology NCU evidence
next_bounded_work.admission_rule: retain the 5.304339 ms absolute Gate threshold and the six-round strict-positive rule
next_bounded_work.scope_guard: test-only until both single-Gate gates clear; run Gate+Up pair only afterward

do_not_repeat: do not describe the fastest native test cell as production-ready while the absolute gate fails
do not relax the absolute gate to admit an otherwise positive result
do not run Gate+Up pair timing after the frozen single-Gate stop-loss
do not route MTP as a shortcut
